dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us7000pufs](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us7000pufs) Magnitude 6.2 earthquake at 10.0 depth occurred on Apr 23 2025 25km SE of Marmara Ereglisi. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude 40.8395 longitude 28.142. It impacted 290437 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
